title: 學員匯入 — Variant C 欄位對映 UI
content: 建立 AF-021 Variant C 的 Presentational `RegistrantColumnMapper`：左側顯示 User 目標欄位與 mapping selector，右側顯示來源欄及少量樣本值。以 source index 區分重複標題；元件不處理 upload/fetch/API 或業務驗證。新增三語 dictionary labels，並登記新元件到 design-system inventory。

findings: 5 component/helper tests passed; all three locale dictionaries parse and typecheck
Desktop/unresolved/mobile screenshots captured; mobile CDP metrics report documentWidth 390 for viewport 390
Component code review found no blocking functional or security issue
evidence.residual: The component is presentational only; AF-021 must wire it to the import API and complete end-to-end flow.

acceptance: Variant C shows target fields and source samples side by side; narrow layouts stack panels and keep the table scrollable
Source options use stable indices and duplicate labels are distinguished by index/column letter
Each source index can map to at most one target; required/optional targets are visually clear
After mapping a source to email, phone, or idDocNumber, mask its displayed sample values
Loading, empty, unresolved, duplicate, disabled, focus, and mobile states are covered
All copy uses en, zh-hk, and zh-cn dictionaries
New mapping component is added to design-system inventory
npm run typecheck and npm run lint pass
